more.title: Information
more.subtitle: Terms of Service and Transparency of GéoEmploi

corps: The Ministry of Job and Happiness provides users with the public digital platform GéoEmploi. This public matching service aims to facilitate direct connections between applicants and recruiters through the localized consultation of job offers at the municipality level.

These Terms of Service govern the access, usage, and data protection rules between the publishing Administration and the service users. Any access or account creation implies full and unreserved acceptance of these provisions.

liste: Any natural person accessing the service to look for jobs, view job listings, or apply.
Any legal entity or professional posting job offers via a dedicated account.
Map layers provided by IGN Geoplateforme and address data provided by the National Address API (api-adresse.data.gouv.fr).

corps: All features available to applicants — map browsing, viewing listings, distance calculation, and application submission — are completely free and require no subscription.

sousArticles.soustitre: 4.1. Transient Processing and No GPS Storage
corps: To sort listings by geographical proximity, users can enable device location through their browser's API. This action requires express technical authorization.
No user GPS coordinates are stored, saved, or tracked in the Ministry's databases or server logs. Proximity calculations are handled entirely in volatile memory during the active session.
Location permission is optional. If refused, users retain full platform capabilities by entering a reference city or postal code manually.
To protect employer privacy and peace of mind, exact postal addresses are not displayed on the public map: only the municipality tied to the listing is visible to users.

articles.titre: Personal Data Protection and User Rights

sousArticles.soustitre: 5.1. Categories of Data Collected at Registration
corps: Under the data minimization principle (Art. 5.1.c GDPR), GéoEmploi collects only data strictly necessary for employment matching:
liste: First name, last name, contact email address, secured password (hashed/encrypted), resume document (PDF/DOC).
Company name, SIRET number, headquarters address, manager first/last name, professional email address, phone number.

table: Period of active use, then deletion after 2 years of continuous inactivity
IPs anonymized within 24 hours, technical logs purged after 12 months

corps: In compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and national data protection laws, every user has the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, and object to the processing of their data.
liste: Update profile details or immediately delete account via « My Account » > « Delete my account ».
Via email at dpo@job-et-bonheur.fr. Response within the statutory limit of one month.
With the CNIL (www.cnil.fr) in case of non-compliance with your rights.

corps: The Ministry exercises due diligence to ensure platform availability and security. It shall not be held liable in cases of force majeure, temporary maintenance disruptions, inaccurate employer listings, or unsuccessful applications.
These Terms of Service are governed by French law. In the absence of an amicable settlement, any dispute regarding their validity or performance shall be submitted to the competent French courts.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.intro: GéoEmploi is a service designed to browse job offers, submit applications, and, for employers, post listings free of charge.

corps: Publishing a job listing on GéoEmploi is entirely free of charge.
No subscription, fee, or financial compensation is required from employers to publish an offer.
Job listings are geolocated at the municipality level. They are mapped to the municipality center, not the precise postal address.
User location may be used to display nearby jobs. This position is not retained by GéoEmploi.
The only retained location data is that tied to the published job listings.
User positions are neither recorded nor retained.
Location data associated with job listings is retained according to records of processing activities.
Location history for listings is automatically deleted after 90 days.
GéoEmploi adheres to data minimization: only data necessary for service operation is collected and retained.
For any inquiry regarding personal data protection or exercising rights, contact the Data Protection Officer (DPO): dpo@job-et-bohneur.fr
